name: installation-mode-governance
description: Tier-P Windows clean-room proof for the non-operative installation-mode resolver: policy precedence with proven provenance, pre-activation legacy pinning, migration-required legacy, sticky namespaced activation, orphaned transfer, maintenance blocking, and read-only evaluation.

inputs.CR_PARTNER_PATH: mounted copilot-extensions source tree; the Windows runner mounts -PartnerPath at C:\partner

stages.title: absent policy selects legacy without writes
proven plugin policy requests activation while legacy remains actual
active namespaced mode stays pinned when policy is removed
stale maintenance marker blocks without auto-clear

notes: Windows-only by design: this scenario exercises the real PowerShell 5.1 evaluator in a disposable Windows container.
The mounted source is read-only; all receipts, policies, ownership records, and reports live in disposable scenario state.
